llm.summary: This skill is a narrowly scoped paid API helper for checking cosmetic ingredients against EU rules, with no bundled executable code or persistence.

dimensions.detail: The requested network POST and payment hash are proportionate to a paid remote compliance-check API. No local file, credential-store, shell, or broad environment access is requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a single Markdown skill file with frontmatter metadata; no installer, scripts, dependencies, or local code execution surface is present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions are limited to when to use the service, request schema, authentication header/body field, and expected responses; there are no role overrides, hidden commands, or broad agent-control instructions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background process, privilege escalation, memory modification, tool hijacking, or system modification behavior appears in the artifact.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The declared purpose and instructions align: submit ingredient lists, target markets, and an x402 payment hash to a disclosed compliance-check endpoint. Users should understand formula data is sent to a third-party service.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, confirm you are comfortable sending cosmetic ingredient lists or potentially proprietary formulation data to the disclosed third-party endpoint and paying 0.10 USDC per check. Treat the returned compliance result as decision support rather than a substitute for qualified regulatory review.
